title: Asahina Mafuyu — Captive Masquerade〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's good... The part Yuki arranged was very well done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I agree♪
Feels like that part made K's composition even more appealing than usual?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, it's pretty much Yuki's usual stuff, though?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which means you think she's usually fantastic, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I said nothing of that sort. Having to go along with her was why we posted this new song late in the first place, so that was the least she could do for us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Enanan, tough outside but soft inside, she is♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Since there are no issues, I'll be logging off soon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What? Already? It's earlier than you usually do, though.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have a committee meeting before morning assembly tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. You should definitely turn in early today, then.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to get ready for bed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It just draws me in for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's nothing inside except aquatic plants and sand...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's just like me. An empty vessel with nothing inside...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Or, at least, that's what I've always thought.
Until...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: How do you know that song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've known this song from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have been singing this song since this SEKAI was first created.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Miku in the SEKAI born from my feelings knew this song from the start. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (So, I'm not...am empty vessel after all? Besides...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, you said before that you can't feel or understand happiness and joy, but I have a different opinion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I think, you've probably just convinced yourself that you can't.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How else would you be able to write lyrics like these?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If Kanade is right, then I should be able to feel as well.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But then, why can I still not feel anything now?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why am I...thinking of that doll again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It makes me feel sick, pain, and agony.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I don't need this.
If that's what feelings are like, then I should just do away with all of them—)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, you're really pale! What happened?
You're not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She came running over almost immediately back then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's similar to the sensations I feel when I meet with Miku in SEKAI and chat with her...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(This doesn't feel painful or agonizing.
I should keep this feeling with me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The way I kept Kanade's song that Miku sang...)
